_notes: Hearthstone Mercenaries starter roster at max power: level-30 stats, tier-5 abilities, tier-4 equipment (tier 1 values in *_t1 fields for tuning). One equipment slot per merc. school null = no spell school. cooldown 0 = none. Source: hearthstone.wiki.gg + in-game card screenshots.

abilities.name: Crusader's Blow
abilities.text: Attack an enemy. Deathblow: Restore 60 Health to this Merc.
abilities.text_t1: Attack an enemy. Deathblow: Restore 10 Health to this Merc.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.text: Restore 12 Health to this Merc and gain Taunt for 3 turns.
abilities.text_t1: Restore 4 Health to this Merc and gain Taunt for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Seal of Light
abilities.text: Restore 15 Health to a friendly character and give it +6 Attack.
abilities.text_t1: Restore 5 Health to a friendly character and give it +2 Attack.

equipment.name: Hammer of Dawn
equipment.text: Crusader's Blow restores Health to your other characters as well.

equipment.name: Tome of Judgment
equipment.text: Seal of Light gives an additional +4 Attack for each of your Alliance characters.

equipment.name: Tome of Light
equipment.text: Passive: While this Merc has Taunt, it has +12 Attack.

abilities.name: Martial Mastery
abilities.text: Gain +5 Health and Attack an enemy. If it's a Fighter, gain +10 Health instead.
abilities.text_t1: Gain +1 Health and Attack an enemy. If it's a Fighter, gain +3 Health instead.

abilities.name: Hold the Front
abilities.text: Gain Taunt for 2 turns. Restore 14 Health to adjacent characters.
abilities.text_t1: Gain Taunt for 2 turns. Restore 4 Health to adjacent characters.

abilities.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
abilities.text: Restore 10 Health to another friendly Merc. Whenever it takes damage this turn, this Merc takes it instead.
abilities.text_t1: Restore 2 Health to another friendly Merc. Whenever it takes damage this turn, this Merc takes it instead.

equipment.name: Striking Gauntlets
equipment.text: Martial Mastery gives 4 more Health.

equipment.name: Band of Enlightenment
equipment.text: Hold the Front restores 8 more Health.

equipment.name: Shield of Dawn
equipment.text: Passive: Take 3 less damage.

abilities.text_t1: Attack an enemy. Deathblow: Give +5 Attack to your Horde characters.

abilities.text_t1: Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Its next ability is (2) Speed slower.

abilities.text_t1: Gain +2 Attack. Attack an enemy and one of its neighbors.

equipment.name: Halting Sash

equipment.name: Bloodthirst Amulet

abilities.text_t1: Attack an enemy. If it was damaged this turn, gain +1 Attack and Attack it again.
